key_points: Corning signs a $3 billion deal, likely tied to AI/data center glass demand.
18 analysts maintain a Buy rating on the stock following the announcement.
UBS raised its price target to $201.00, indicating upside potential.
Zacks recommends GLW as a Q3 AI data center laggard expected to rebound in Q4.
Shares dipped ~2.4% ahead of the October 27 earnings release, reflecting short-term profit-taking.
